evidence.name: Screen field: Outline thickness
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Outline thickness" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Outline thickness
sections.description: Draws an outline around the section. The default 0 means no border; 1 to 2 pixels gives a subtle frame that makes a section read as a self-contained card or highlights an offer. Set this above 0 first, then pick the border color below.
